datasets.name: headline
datasets.displayName: One row of headline numbers for the overview counters.
queryLines:
select
  (select effect_pct from workspace.nfip.results_pricing_adequacy
    where model = 'A_claim_frequency_per_class_step' and coefficient = 'class_steps')   as claims_per_step_pct,
  (select effect_pct from workspace.nfip.results_pricing_adequacy
    where model = 'A_loss_cost_per_class_step' and coefficient = 'class_steps')        as loss_cost_per_step_pct,
  (select total_expected_abs_gap_usd / 1e6 from workspace.nfip.results_pooled_summary) as expected_abs_gap_musd,
  (select total_evsi_half_variance_usd / 1e6 from workspace.nfip.results_pooled_summary) as evsi_musd,
  (select mde_pct from workspace.nfip.results_c_power_design
    where design = 'within_county' and outcome = 'claim_frequency'
    order by n_entrants limit 1)                                                       as entry_mde_claims_pct

datasets.name: losses_by_year
datasets.displayName: Panel totals by year and state, 2010 to 2024; rates are computed in the widgets
queryLines:
select year, state,
       sum(earned_policy_years)                                   as policy_years,
       sum(n_claims)                                              as claims,
       sum(paid_total) / 1e6                                      as paid_musd
from workspace.nfip.gold_community_year_panel
where year between 2010 and 2024
group by year, state

datasets.name: class_decision
datasets.displayName: Pricing decision by CRS class: pooled relativity vs scheduled discount, and the
queryLines:
select concat('Class ', crs_bin)                                  as crs_class,
       round(pooled_effect_pct, 1)                                as pooled_loss_cost_effect_pct,
       round(pooled_low90_pct, 1)                                 as low90_pct,
       round(pooled_high90_pct, 1)                                as high90_pct,
       round(scheduled_discount_pct, 1)                           as scheduled_discount_pct,
       round(pooled_effect_pct + scheduled_discount_pct, 1)       as losses_above_discount_pts,
       round(100 * p_discount_too_generous, 0)                    as p_too_generous_pct,
       round(expected_gap_usd / 1e6, 1)                           as expected_gap_musd,
       round(best_discount_pct, 1)                                as best_discount_pct,
       round(evpi_usd / 1e6, 1)                                   as evpi_musd,
       round(evsi_half_variance_usd / 1e6, 1)                     as evsi_half_variance_musd
from workspace.nfip.results_pricing_decision

datasets.name: entry_design
datasets.displayName: Placebo simulation of the CRS entry difference-in-differences: detectable effect
queryLines:
select concat(case design when 'within_county' then 'Within county' else 'Year FE only' end, ', ',
              replace(outcome, '_', ' '))                         as design_outcome,
       n_entrants,
       round(mde_pct, 1)                                          as mde_pct,
       round(100 * false_positive_rate, 0)                        as false_positive_rate_pct,
       round(placebo_mean_pct, 1)                                 as bias_under_no_effect_pct
from workspace.nfip.results_c_power_design

datasets.name: experiment_power
datasets.displayName: Proposed randomized CRS recruitment trial: detectable drop in claims by design a
queryLines:
select concat(case assignment when 'within_county' then 'Within county' else 'Whole counties' end, ', ',
              replace(analysis, '_', ' '))                        as design,
       case size when 'all' then 'All eligible' else concat('~', size, ' pilot') end as trial_size,
       cast(n_communities as int)                                 as communities,
       round(itt_mde_pct, 1)                                      as itt_mde_pct,
       round(complier_mde_pct_p50, 1)                             as complier_mde_pct_at_50pct_uptake,
       round(complier_mde_pct_p25, 1)                             as complier_mde_pct_at_25pct_uptake
from workspace.nfip.results_e_experiment_power
where outcome = 'n_claims'

datasets.name: pipeline_health
datasets.displayName: Quality checks from the latest job run.
queryLines:
select check_name, layer, severity, failing_rows, passed,
       case when passed then 0 when severity = 'error' then 1 else 0 end as blocking
from workspace.nfip.ops_dq_results
where run_at = (select max(run_at) from workspace.nfip.ops_dq_results)

datasets.name: load_log
datasets.displayName: Latest silver load per dataset, with file vs table row counts.
queryLines:
select dataset, file_rows, table_rows, status, loaded_at
from workspace.nfip.ops_load_log
qualify row_number() over (partition by dataset order by loaded_at desc) = 1

lines:
# Are FEMA's CRS flood insurance discounts priced right?
Communities in FEMA's Community Rating System get 5% off flood insurance per class step. This dashboard compares
those discounts with observed losses across 335,000 NFIP community-years (2010 to 2024), within the same county and
year so communities faced the same storms. Pipeline, methods, and caveats: [GitHub repo](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/nfip-crs-measurement).

frame.title: Claims per class step (%)
frame.description: Within county and year; schedule is -5% per step

frame.title: Expected pricing gap ($M/yr)
frame.description: Expected absolute gap between schedule and expected loss, CRS classes

frame.title: Value of halving uncertainty ($M/yr)
frame.description: Expected reduction in pricing gap from twice the evidence

lines:
## Pricing decision by CRS class
Class relativities are partially pooled in a Bayesian hierarchical model, with uncertainty widened by
placebo tests. **Losses above discount** is the pooled loss cost relative to non-CRS neighbors plus the
scheduled discount: above zero, the class loses more than its discount assumes. Re-pricing on today's
evidence barely reduces the expected gap; better data (recovering historical CRS classes) is worth far more.

frame.title: Losses above discount (points)
frame.description: Pooled loss cost vs non-CRS neighbors, plus the scheduled discount

frame.title: Probability the discount is too generous
Decision table
frame.description: Dollars are expected annual loss at 2022 to 2024 exposure and 2010 to 2024 loss cost

lines:
## Can the causal effect of joining CRS be measured?
**Left:** placebo simulations of the entry difference-in-differences. The original design (year fixed
effects only) was biased (+41% with no true effect) and flagged fake effects 25% of the time; comparing
within county and year fixes the bias but detects only large effects. **Right:** a proposed randomized
recruitment trial. It can measure whether outreach raises participation, but not a realistic effect on claims.

frame.title: Randomized trial: detectable drop in claims
